positive_rule: Native record layer implied by the implemented exposure construct
Native MIMIC table/source or unambiguous native extract explicitly named
Field, code, explicit list, regex, reusable query, or equivalent executable identity rule
Both time origin and interval/state boundary operationally specified
Executable native predicate distinguishes delivery from non-delivery event states
Dose, route, formulation, concentration, or exposure-level dose/route rule stated
Native source AND identity rule AND time rule AND event semantics
All article-linked supplementary files accounted for
Article-specific linked repository accounted for; generic MIMIC repositories do not qualify
Article section, supplement filename, or repository URL/path
